title: 容性负载的复功率
statement: V̇_s = 100∠30° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 6 Ω 与 C = 125 µF 串联。
用复功率 S̄ = V̇·İ*（İ* 为电流相量的共轭）求负载吸收的有功功率与无功功率，并判断功率因数的性质。

questions.ask: 电流相量 İ 的初相 φ_i = ?
负载吸收的有功功率 P = ?
负载吸收的无功功率 Q = ?（即电容吸收的无功）
questions.explain: Q = Im S̄ = −800 var，也等于 −I²X_C = −100 × 8。负号表示负载实际上向电源发出无功。

questions.ask: 这个负载的功率因数 cos φ = 0.6，它是
choiceExplain: 当成滞后通常是把 φ_i − φ_v 当成了阻抗角，或忘了 RC 负载是容性的；阻抗角是 φ = φ_v − φ_i。
只看 cos φ = 0.6 确实分不出超前滞后，因为 cos 是偶函数。但这里电压、电流的相位都能求出来，看阻抗角（或 Q）的正负就能判断。
questions.explain: 阻抗角 φ = φ_v − φ_i = 30° − 83.13° = −53.13° < 0，电流超前电压，Q < 0：容性负载，功率因数超前。

hints: 先求 X_C = 1/(ωC) 和 Z，再求 I。
复功率 S̄ = V̇·İ*：模相乘，角度相减（φ_v − φ_i）；实部是 P，虚部是 Q。
solution: **验算：** S̄ = I²Z = 100 × (6 − j8) = 600 − j800 VA ✓。注意不能写成 V̇·İ（不取共轭）：那样得到 1000∠113.13°，没有物理意义。

en.title: Complex power of a capacitive load
statement: V̇_s = 100∠30° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R = 6 Ω in series with C = 125 µF.
Using the complex power S̄ = V̇·İ* (İ* is the conjugate of the current phasor), find the real and reactive power absorbed by the load and decide the nature of its power factor.

questions.ask: Phase angle of the current phasor İ, φ_i = ?
Real power absorbed by the load, P = ?
Reactive power absorbed by the load, Q = ? (i.e. absorbed by the capacitor)
questions.explain: Q = Im S̄ = −800 var, which also equals −I²X_C = −100 × 8. The minus sign means the load actually delivers reactive power to the source.

questions.ask: The load's power factor is cos φ = 0.6. It is
choiceExplain: Calling it lagging usually means taking φ_i − φ_v as the impedance angle, or forgetting that an RC load is capacitive; the impedance angle is φ = φ_v − φ_i.
cos φ = 0.6 alone cannot tell, because cosine is even. But the voltage and current phases can be found here, and the sign of the impedance angle (or of Q) settles it.
questions.explain: The impedance angle φ = φ_v − φ_i = 30° − 83.13° = −53.13° < 0: the current leads the voltage and Q < 0 — a capacitive load with a leading power factor.

hints: Find X_C = 1/(ωC) and Z first, then I.
Complex power S̄ = V̇·İ*: multiply the magnitudes and subtract the angles (φ_v − φ_i); the real part is P, the imaginary part is Q.
solution: **Check:** S̄ = I²Z = 100 × (6 − j8) = 600 − j800 VA ✓. Note that V̇·İ without the conjugate would give 1000∠113.13°, which has no physical meaning.
